items.summary: Verify that frontend/index.html contains a div element with id='root' in the body section, and if missing, add it with the exact markup:

Verify that frontend/src/main.tsx correctly targets the root element using document.getElementById('root') and includes a null check with fallback error logging if the element is not found, displaying a visible error message in the console and on the page if mounting fails

Add comprehensive try-catch blocks around the ReactDOM.createRoot and root.render calls in frontend/src/main.tsx that catch any initialization errors, log them with full stack traces to console.error, and display a user-visible error message directly to document.body

Add console.log statements at the very beginning of frontend/src/main.tsx (before any imports) and immediately before the createRoot call to trace execution flow, logging 'main.tsx: Script loaded' and 'main.tsx: About to mount React app' respectively

Verify that all import statements in frontend/src/main.tsx resolve correctly by checking that imported modules (React, ReactDOM, App component, QueryClientProvider, InternetIdentityProvider) exist and have valid exports, wrapping imports in try-catch if necessary to catch module resolution errors

Add defensive initialization checks to InternetIdentityProvider in frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts to ensure it never throws uncaught errors during context setup, wrapping any AuthClient initialization or async calls in try-catch blocks with error logging and fallback to unauthenticated state

Verify that the App component in frontend/src/App.tsx exports correctly as the default export and that it renders without throwing errors by temporarily replacing its content with a simple div displaying 'App component loaded successfully' to isolate rendering issues
